# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low volatility (ribbon compression), a bullish market structure shift (BOS) signals the start of a new trend leg, offering a high-probability long entry. The compression filter ensures we only trade when volatility is contracted, reducing false breakouts, while the BOS requirement confirms institutional participation and directional bias.

## Mechanism

Enter long when: (1) ribbon (8,21,55 EMA) is compressed, defined as (8-period EMA - 55-period EMA) absolute value < 20-period average of that distance for 5+ consecutive bars; (2) bullish market structure shift occurs - either price makes a higher high (HH) followed by a higher low (HL) above the prior swing high, OR breaks above prior swing high with the breakout bar showing a HL above the prior swing low; (3) close > 21 EMA. Exit: initial stop at recent swing low or 1.5x ATR below entry (whichever is tighter); take 50% profit at 1.5R; trail remaining position with chandelier exit (3x ATR, 22-period) OR exit if 8 EMA crosses below 21 EMA. Regime filters: only trade when VIX < 15 and time between 9:30-11:30 EST; avoid during FOMC/CPI events and when VIX > 25.
